items.title: What happens to Canadian science in orbit after the International Space Station is decommissioned?
items.summary: The International Space Station (ISS) is scheduled to be decommissioned in 2030, and the central question everybody’s asking is: what’s next? The answer, at least outside of China, is commercially owned and operated space stations: ones that do much of what the ISS does, but with different approaches and structures. items.summary: In-space manufacturing startup Helogen today announced two upcoming missions of its HEL-IOS biomaterials manufacturing platform, both scheduled to launch in October.
